summary: This 8-K reports a non-unanimous settlement in a regulatory rate case filed by Public Service Company of Colorado (a Xcel Energy subsidiary) with the CPUC. The settlement proposes a $225M revenue increase (6.3%), a 9.3% ROE, and a 54.5% equity ratio, among other terms. No corporate transaction, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved. The filing is a routine update on a utility regulatory proceeding, not a special situation.
